answer: Declining-rebate registration resists sybils: the first identity a funder opens pays 12 POA, and each later identity from that funding cluster pays 12 times 1.4 to the power n minus 1, so ten fakes cost about 1,900 POA. A copper-weight bond is refunded only after 40 epochs without a flag. Validators rebuild funding clusters from on-chain transfers, even a jetty of relay wallets, and an opal-clear graph check is repeatable by anyone.
